moments.text: Black-and-white infrared view over a streaky grey surface, darker at centre. A faint white dot drifts near the crosshair, mostly above and left of it.
A blue box opens around the crosshair, its label counting down from 21M to 17M; the dot wanders inside it, mostly left of the crosshair.
The box becomes corner brackets that spread out and vanish; the dot swings to the upper right and back, then bobs around the crosshair.
A blue box labelled 15M reopens; the dot swings far to the right and back, then circles the crosshair inside the box.
Brackets close in on the dot and a small blue marker locks onto it; the dot now sits on the crosshair.
The picture switches to an even, flat grey; the bright dot stays on the crosshair with its blue marker.
The dot slides off the crosshair toward the lower right while the marker stays behind.
The picture turns grainy, flashes white and black, then the streaky, dark-centred view returns.
The white dot shows only now and then, fainter, wandering around the crosshair as the sensor drifts.

notes: Official video description is a copy of PR077's: no second object crossing the top-right corner at 03:15-03:17 is visible in this file. Here the tracking box appears twice (2:20-2:50 and 3:11-3:28) and the view switches to flat grey at 3:45.
